notes: zmean + term size: the term-size coefficient sits at its sign bound (0), so this model equals zmean only.

Simple models: sign-constrained logistic (src/calibration.MonotoneLogistic), 10-fold cluster cross-fitting with fold seeds 0–4 (as §3.7), primary PMID clusters; bootstrap = 2,000 cluster resamples (seed 0) of OOF predictions (slope/intercept/Brier/c) or refits (Sigma). U support = used covariates within H 5th–95th percentiles, no family restriction. Top 40 under a simple model follows scripts/46 (expressed, assessable, §4.3 exclusions, contradictions, mito cap); contradictions were evaluated only for the original support set, so new entrants are unchecked for contradiction.
